scheme_name: AGR 3 (Farm Mechanization) Scheme For ST Farmers
other_conditions: Farmer must belong to Scheduled Tribe category in the 208 talukas where the SMAM scheme is not implemented
Beneficiary must be residing in Talukas/Blocks and Districts covered under the Agriculture Support Program in Tribal Area Sub Plan & Dispersed Tribes (TASP)
Farmer must purchase agricultural equipment from an authorized manufacturer as listed by the agriculture department
benefits_summary: Financial assistance for purchase of agricultural equipment and subsidized seeds/fertilizer for ST farmers in Gujarat.
